errors.evidence: The first bar on the x-axis is labeled “股份回购” (Share buyback), not “股东回购” (Shareholder buyback). While similar, it's not the exact label.
The description incorrectly identifies the second category as “专项” (Special project), when the chart label is “亏损” (Loss).
The description incorrectly identifies the seventh category as “股东赠与” (Shareholder gift), when the chart label is “股东减持” (Shareholder reduction).
The description nonsensically identifies the eighth category as “解囊保研” (loosening one's purse for postgraduate recommendation), when the chart label is “解除质押” (Release of pledge).
The description incorrectly identifies the eleventh category as “股东赠与” (Shareholder gift), when the chart label is “股东增持” (Shareholder increase).
The description incorrectly identifies the twelfth category as “企业解聘” (Corporate dismissal), when the chart label is “企业破产” (Corporate bankruptcy).
The description claims the y-axis has a label “样本数量” (sample quantity), but the y-axis has no label in the image.
The value for the first bar, “股份回购”, is approximately 1300, not "近似1400" (approximately 1400).
The value for “企业收购” is approximately 930, not 1000. This is a significant overestimate.
The value for “高管变动” is closer to 890, making the approximation of 850 an underestimate.
The value for the seventh bar (“股东减持”) is approximately 870, not 800. This is a significant underestimate.
The value for the eighth bar (“解除质押”) is approximately 720, not 650. This is a significant underestimate.
The value for “公司上市” is approximately 480, not 600. This is a significant overestimate.
The value for the eleventh bar (“股东增持”) is approximately 320, not 550. This is a very large overestimate.
The value for the twelfth bar (“企业破产”) is approximately 240, not 450. This is a very large overestimate.
The value for “被约谈” is approximately 170, not 250. This is a significant overestimate.
The description omits several categories from the x-axis, including “亏损”, “质押”, “企业融资”, “股东增持”, and “企业破产”, instead providing incorrect labels for some of these.
The description fails to mention that the bars are sorted in descending order of their values from left to right.
